title: Blink of an Eye (Nether boss Blacksmith Ianne, traits 1351-1353)
problem: Text: 10% per hit (tiers 2-3), maximum 95%. Code: 5% per hit, clamped at the shared 80% cap. Aligning to text makes this boss harder.
notes: Fix: K: 0.05→0.1 (×2); S: six cap loads → static 0.95 — in patch (byte-verified)

release_notes.effect: Blink of an Eye (Nether boss Blacksmith Ianne)
release_notes.intended: The boss takes less damage for each time it was hit this battle (10% per hit on its higher tiers), up to 95%.
release_notes.actual: In the unpatched game, it used 5% per hit and stopped at 80%.
release_notes.fix: Now its higher tiers use 10% per hit, up to 95%.
